items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there he came in with Hazel Scott and got a table right up front to see Bird, him and Hazel Scott.

ctx.x: He married Hazel Scott. Did you have – as he evolved politically and you evolved musically, was there ever any connection?

No, it wasn’t anything like that, except one night I was at the Royal Roost to see Bird. I must have been about 18, 17 maybe. We were at a table, me and my boys, just sitting there, and I looked up, and there he came in with Hazel Scott and got a table right up front to see Bird, him and Hazel Scott.
When did you stop going to Abyssinian? When did that shaping of your life – were you 17, still going there?
